reports.title: Federal Realty Investment Trust Reports Strong Third Quarter 2026 Results and Guidance Raise

guidance.heading: 2026 Guidance
section: Federal Realty has tightened its 2026 earnings per diluted share guidance, and raised and tightened its Nareit FFO and Core FFO guidance, as summarized in the table below:

Full Year 2026 Guidance | Revised Guidance | Prior Guidance
Net income available for common shareholders per diluted share | $4.23 to $4.27 | $4.22 to $4.30
Nareit FFO per diluted share | $7.54 to $7.58 | $7.48 to $7.56
Core FFO per diluted share | $7.54 to $7.58 | $7.48 to $7.56
Comparable Property POI Growth | 3.375% to 3.625% | 3.25% to 3.75%
Adjusted Comparable Property POI Growth | 4.375% to 4.625% | 4.00% to 4.50%
% Core FFO growth over the prior year | 6.8% - 7.4% | 5.9% - 7.1%
